children: Large investors on decentralized exchange Hyperliquid have flipped their Bitcoin
positioning from net long to net short for the first time in seven months.
Glassnode said on Nov. 8 that whale investors on Hyperliquid now hold more short positions in Bitcoin than long positions.
It marks the first time in seven months that those investors have shifted to a net short stance.
Short-position exposure has climbed to its highest level since October 2025.

title: Glassnode Says Hyperliquid Whales Turn Net Short on Bitcoin for First Time in 7 Months
